articles.title: Analyze This: Microbes can make valuable chemicals more sustainable
articles.snippet: Food waste-fed bacteria may someday make chemical ingredients for medicines, cosmetics and more.
articles.summary: Bacteria fed on food waste might one day be used to create chemical ingredients for medicines and cosmetics. This process could help make the production of these valuable chemicals more sustainable.

articles.title: Would growing a big heart make the Grinch strong?
articles.snippet: In the classic Dr. Seuss tale, the Grinch’s heart grows in an instant. That probably wouldn’t have been good for him — unless he was a snake.
articles.summary: In the classic Dr. Seuss tale, the Grinch's heart grows instantly, which probably would not have been good for him. However, this sudden growth might have been fine if he was a snake.

articles.title: Toys inspired this moon rover’s unique design
articles.snippet: After transforming from a ball into a wheeled robot, this small rover crawled along the lunar surface, taking photos.
articles.summary: A toy-inspired lunar rover transformed from a ball into a wheeled robot on the moon. While moving along the lunar surface, the small robot also took photos.
